title: The Tasmanian Devil Has the Strongest Bite for Its Size

scenes.text: An animal under 20 pounds bites through bone.
It's the Tasmanian devil, and males top out near 18 pounds.
But scientists rate its bite as the strongest for its body size of any living mammal carnivore.
It tears apart meat and crushes bones.
It eats the whole animal, bones included.
Under 20 pounds. Bones don't stand a chance.

description:
An animal under 20 pounds bites through bone.
The Tasmanian devil has the strongest bite for its body size of any living mammal carnivore, and it eats whole animals, bones and all.
What is the toughest small animal you know?
first_comment: Under 20 pounds and it crushes bone. Would you trust a Tasmanian devil's bite?
